visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty five: the mirror is right (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js hair salon with bulb mirrors and hood dryers, box-built character in rollers, mirror / post stats with retention curve / submit draft / review verdict with hook card and timeline pages, a daisy that loses petals, a coin, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.6 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: is her video any good? The mirror says she looks tired, the daisy says post it, the coin says heads; she posts and everyone leaves at second two. Then YourBrand: upload the draft before posting, get 'No, minor changes first' with the hook and the dead air marked on a timeline, fix both, 'Yes, good to post'. The mirror is still right.
